name: Mohit Rajput
title: Backend & AI Engineer
tagline: Backend & AI Engineer. I design systems that don't just work at scale — they stay honest under pressure.
availability: Available for senior backend and AI infrastructure roles, remote-first
philosophy: Build to understand. Share what you learn.
about: I spent the first year of my career obsessed with syntax and frameworks. Then a production outage at 2am taught me something no documentation had: systems fail in the gaps between what was documented and what was assumed.

Since then, my approach has shifted. I spend more time in architecture reviews and postmortems than I do in feature PRs. The most important engineering decisions are invisible to users — they live in consistency models, failure modes, and deployment strategies.
This portfolio is a public record of that process. Not a highlight reel — a working journal. The hard decisions, the wrong turns, the things I'd do differently.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Systems over syntax
engineeringPrinciples.body: Technology choices are consequences of constraints. I start with the problem, not the tool.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Make it boring
engineeringPrinciples.body: The most reliable systems are the most predictable ones. Cleverness is a liability at 3am.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Public learning
engineeringPrinciples.body: Writing about what I build sharpens my own thinking. Every post is a second draft of an architecture.

engineeringPrinciples.title: Instrument everything
engineeringPrinciples.body: You cannot reason about systems you cannot observe. Observability is a precondition, not a feature.
